title: Would love to get some fresh opinions on my game as it is currently
author: TalesofEternitydev
selftext:
(I know the arts not great its a big struggle as of right now but id rather work on the core systems then stress the art for now)

Tales of Eternity is a 2D pixel-art fantasy RPG that you can play alone or with other people in a shared online world (i have an active server running at the moment). It plays in the browser on itchio, on a phone or a PC.

I have the link set up on my reddit profile and page i set up for my game!

Turn based combat that happens actively on the map. Each turn you pick three moves from your set, and when your energy is full you can fire off a big ultimate. Going for a strategic type of combat where the enemies show what they will be doing above their head and allows for counterplay.

Other than just the combat we have tons to do:

Gear: Looting is going to be an essential part of the grind getting perfect rolls on the right set will provide so much extra power.

Classes: choose one of seven, each with its own moves and role. Some are more support oriented but every class can play everything solo.

Pets and collecting: every creature and boss has a pet to collect, plus a rare mythic version. There are boss trophies and a creature encyclopedia too. This is somewhat similar to Pokémon shiny hunting!

Skills: chop wood, mine, fish and cook.

Your hideout: a cozy home to build and decorate, with a garden that grows in real time to farm for food buff recipes. There's also several upgrade benches in the hideout to upgrade your gear

End game/core loop content: world bosses, exploration dungeons, a deep tower called the Depths, Nightmare dungeons, and player duels.

Any feedback is appreciated, i have a reddit page for the game or the forums on the itchio page! thank you for anyone who gives it a chance. Thanks to anyone who gives it a shot!!!
